title: Among customers who made purchases at gas stations in the Czech Republic an
question: Among customers who made purchases at gas stations in the Czech Republic and paid in EUR, which segment—SME, LAM, or KAM—had the highest percentage increase in total consumption from 2012 to 2013?

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
      AND g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2013
    FROM qualifying_customers qc
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON qc.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    GROUP BY qc.XCL_002
)
SELECT segment
FROM segment_consumption
WHERE sum_2012 > 0
ORDER BY ((sum_2013 - sum_2012) * 100.0 / sum_2012) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
      AND g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2013
    FROM qualifying_customers qc
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON qc.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    GROUP BY qc.XCL_002
)
SELECT segment
FROM segment_consumption
WHERE sum_2012 > 0
ORDER BY ((sum_2013 - sum_2012) * 100.0 / sum_2012) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
      AND g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2013
    FROM qualifying_customers qc
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON qc.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    GROUP BY qc.XCL_002
)
SELECT segment
FROM segment_consumption
WHERE sum_2012 > 0
ORDER BY ((sum_2013 - sum_2012) * 100.0 / sum_2012) DESC
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH czech_eur_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        t.XCL_011 AS transaction_date,
        t.XCL_018 AS consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_014 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE g.XCL_007 = 'Czech Republic'
      AND t.XCL_012 = 'EUR'
),
customer_segments AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        c.XCL_003 AS segment
    FROM customers c
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        cs.segment,
        CASE
            WHEN strftime('%Y', cet.transaction_date) = '2012' THEN '2012'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', cet.transaction_date) = '2013' THEN '2013'
        END AS year,
        SUM(cet.consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM czech_eur_transactions cet
    JOIN customer_segments cs ON cet.customer_id = cs.customer_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', cet.transaction_date) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY cs.segment,
             CASE
                 WHEN strftime('%Y', cet.transaction_date) = '2012' THEN '2012'
                 WHEN strftime('%Y', cet.transaction_date) = '2013' THEN '2013'
             END
),
segment_growth AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT
    segment
FROM segment_growth
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0
ORDER BY (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012 DESC
LIMIT 1
